 NPL: Janakpur to face Sudurpaschim today 
 Nepal News 
 November 10, 2026 
 1 MIN READ 
 A 
 A+ 
 A- 
 content_copy 
 bookmark_border 
 KATHMANDU: The Nepal Premier League (NPL) T-20 cricket tournament continues today with a match between Janakpur Bolts and Sudurpaschim Royals.
 The game is scheduled to take place at the Tribhuvan International Cricket Ground in Kirtipur, starting at 5 pm.
 Sudurpaschim Royals aim to maintain their momentum and secure a victory. Having played five matches, the team has recorded three wins and two losses, placing them third in the standings with six points. They are entering the field with the goal of strengthening their playoff prospects.
 Meanwhile, Janakpur Bolts are looking to make a comeback with a win. They have also played five matches, resulting in two wins and three losses, which leaves them in fifth place with four points. The ongoing competition features eight teams and is scheduled to run until Mangsir 5.
